summary.headline: Moon in Planetary Houses
summary.text: Astrological significations of a planet in the houses of the Sun, Venus, its own house, and the Moon, including intellect, hidden sciences, commerce, anger, pilgrimage, and religious associations. Chapter VII then treats the Moon in Saturn’s, Jupiter’s, and Mars’s houses, with effects on the native, mother, health, fortune, sexual transgression, scandals, soldiers, and robbers.
